title: Pointwise identity at parameter one
statement: For every pair of nonnegative integers $n,m$, every real-valued function $f$ on $\{−1,1\}^n$, and every $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, the noise operator with parameter $1$, applied to $f$ and evaluated at $x$, equals $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$x$ is a point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube
